notes.title: Demo Timer Removed – You Asked, We Listened!
notes.content:
[h2][b]The demo timer is gone. For good.[/b][/h2][p]A lot of players asked for it, and we totally get it — a timer in a board game doesn’t exactly scream "chill time with your friends" So we went back, looked at the feedback, and said "screw that"[/p][p]No more countdown. No more pressure. You can try [i]Board Game Society[/i] as much as you like, whenever you like. Whether you're solo testing mechanics or pulling a friend in for a match, it's all fully available, no strings attached.[/p][p]So feel free to explore the board, find little secrets, and experience an early snippet of what's to come. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Thanks for all the feedback, now give us even more![/b][/h2][p]We’re incredibly grateful for everyone who took the time to play and share their thoughts. It really helps shape where we go next. And to make it even easier, we've added a [b]FEEDBACK[/b] button in the pause menu, while playing the game so you can quickly and easily give us your feedback on the go. [/p][p][/p][p]Give it another go if you’ve been waiting — or tell a friend that the time limit’s no longer a thing.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this with us.
[b]– The Jetebra Games team[/b][/p]

notes.title: We Want To Hear Your Ideas!
notes.content: [h2]Hi Everyone![/h2][p]We’re thrilled to share the first public demo of Board Game Society with you during Steam Next Fest! 🎉[/p][p]This is a big milestone for us, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.[/p][p][/p][h2]🎲 Tried the demo? Help shape the game![/h2][p]We’re looking for [i]your[/i] thoughts, ideas, and bug reports. [/p][p]Whether it’s a clever mechanic you loved or something that felt off. [/p][p]We want to know.[/p][p][/p][h2]💬 Best way to reach us? Join our Discord![/h2][p]That’s where we’re most active, and you’ll get the [i]fastest replies[/i]. [/p][p]Plus, it’s a great place to chat with fellow fans and follow our development journey.[/p][p]Additionally, you can also use the voice channels to play with voiceover.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][url="https://discord.gg/2k3Hx4NmHa" style="button" buttoncolor="#6428bd"]Join our Discord[/url][/b][/h2][p][/p][h2]👉 Second best way? Steam Discussions![/h2][p]You can also post in the Steam Discussions if you prefer, [/p][p]just know it might take us a bit longer to reply there.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this first step with us. [/p][p]We’re so excited to see your reactions![/p][p][/p][p]// Jetebra Games [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063685/ed4aae3d6a986521a1406f3eeb10584da42a825f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
